mapper.select: SELECT provider, base_url, model, encrypted_api_key, api_key_fingerprint FROM llm_provider_configs WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO llm_provider_configs( user_id, provider, base_url, model, encrypted_api_key, api_key_fingerprint ) VALUES ( CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{provider, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{baseUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{model, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{encryptedApiKey, jdbcType=VARBINARY}, #{apiKeyFingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET provider = EXCLUDED.provider, base_url = EXCLUDED.base_url, model = EXCLUDED.model, encrypted_api_key = EXCLUDED.encrypted_api_key, api_key_fingerprint = EXCLUDED.api_key_fingerprint, updated_at = now()
